newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece goes ahead with full debt dematerialisation.
newsitem.headline: Greece goes ahead with full debt dematerialisation.

text.p: Bank of Greece Governor Lucas Papademos and deputy Finance Minister Nikos Christodoulakis signed a decree on July 23, allowing all outstanding physical state debt paper to be converted into book-entry form, the ministry said in a statement.
"This decision satisfies a long-standing request of credit institutions and strengthens the secondary bond market," it said.
The terms, procedure and relevant details will be set in consultation with banks, it added.
